column1: # label-retired.tsv (harbor#1427) — the labels the register retires: not a label source, a deny list.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. label-axes.tsv is the only list of labels (harbor#1427). A label that carried state the
# issue already carries (open, closed, blocked) has no register row and no rename, so without a row here the sync
# could only call it unregistered. A row here makes that a plan line: `bin/standard-label-sync.sh` lists its
# removal, and executes it only with --apply --remove-retired. Nothing here is removed by a plain --apply.
#   id           a label name, or a prefix ending in * (every label that starts with it)
#   replaced_by  the register label whose meaning absorbs it, or - when the issue's own state carries it

column3: state is the issue state (open, closed) or the blocked axis; a status label is a second copy that drifts (harbor#1423 condition 8)
